activity_summary: At dusk you said the tyrant was gone, and no bigger than a pea. You said you had given a king a better speech at his going. You did not add a moral, and you did not call the jaw healed.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the two sentences and did not go on.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Gone. A month's tyrant, and no bigger than a pea.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I gave a king a better speech at his going.
